exposure: presence and size of vein-to-vein (VV) anastomosis
outcome: birth weight discordance relative to placental discordance (BWR/PR)
cohort: The study included 247 placentas from monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies that were part of two previous prospective studies.
finding: Vein-to-vein anastomoses are associated with a decreased birth weight discordance relative to placental sharing discordance, independent of artery-to-artery anastomoses.
